text:
maria: quick heads-up — during the eu1 TLS rekey window we saw SSE streams remain TCP-up but deliver no event frames for ~30-90s, then resume. console shows no socket close; clients see a gap.

sam: any trace id?

maria: trace a1b2c3 -> https://console/redwood/trace/a1b2c3. ops-bot fired `sse.no-output`.

jonathan: my hunch: keepalive-squelch suppressed pings during rekey; client-side reconnect debounce avoided reopen.

lee: paste the repro curl?

maria: ```
curl -v -H "Accept: text/event-stream" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "https://eu1-api.redwood.ai/v1/streams?model=gpt-xxx" --max-time 120
```

maria: behavior: TCP stays established (no FIN/RST), no SSE frames for ~45s, then frames resume mid-response. chat UIs show spinner and often don't surface resumed tokens.

ops-bot: ALERT sse.no-output spike -> 97 events in 10m (eu1). top tenants: acct-42, acct-77.

sam: metrics: `sse.keepalive_suppressed_total` spikes line up with `proxy.tls_rekey_count`. low trace sampling; increasing to 10%.

jonathan: proposals: server emit `x-rekey-hint` header during rekey; client implement short stall->reconnect heuristic (e.g., if `x-rekey-hint` and no frames >10s, resume); telemetry add `sse.stall_duration_seconds` and labels (route, tenant, model); ops temporarily lower squelch threshold in eu1.

lee: ops can flip threshold to 0.5 now. sam, can you add canary flag and console banner?

sam: on it. creating flag + dashboard tile.

maria: created runbook RB-2219 and assigned owners: maria (investigate), sam (telemetry/flags), jonathan (runtime header), lee (ops). target hotfix today, full fix in next release.

jonathan: we should also document cost/duplication tradeoffs for forced reconnect. product to weigh in if forced reconnect acceptable.

maria: product prefers resume but wants UX fix so resumed tokens surface; they'll decide on forced reconnect if UX can't be solved.

lee: will monitor after rollback. update RB-2219 with traces and customer list.

maria: thanks team — will post a short PM with postmortem and next steps. :thumbsup:
